title: LemonMatrix Audio Generation Benchmark Result
description: A single audio-generation benchmark run for one model (Lemonade's acestep/thinksound recipes -- text/music/sound-effect generation, not speech -- via POST /v1/audio/generations). Deliberately separate from tts_result.schema.json even though the metric shape overlaps: generating music/sound effects is a different task with a different compute profile than text-to-speech, so the two are never mixed on the same leaderboard. Also deliberately separate from result.schema.json: real-time-factor is not comparable to LLM token throughput.

run_id.description: Unique identifier for this run (UUID recommended).

timestamp.description: UTC timestamp when the run started.

name.description: Model id as registered in Lemonade, e.g. ACE-Step-v1.

checkpoint.description: Underlying HF checkpoint, if known, e.g. owner/repo.

config.description: The matrix axes for this run.

power_cap_w.description: Applied power cap in watts, if power_state is power_capped.

environment.description: Fingerprint of the machine and software stack. Auto-discovered from the profile. Required for any run to be comparable.

igpu_family.description: AMD GPU ROCm architecture codename, e.g. gfx1151.

dgpu_family.description: AMD GPU ROCm architecture codename, e.g. gfx950 -- confirmed more reliable than name for at least one real datacenter card whose name field was a bare numeric string.

backend_version.description: Version of the underlying audio-gen engine build, if Lemonade reports it as installed.

metrics.description: Generation latency and real-time-factor. Duration is measured from the generated WAV's own header (exact), and generation time is measured client-side as wall-clock time around the request -- this times the network round trip to whatever machine the profile actually points at, not local hardware.

generation_time_ms.description: Mean wall-clock time to generate one clip.

audio_duration_s.description: Mean duration of the generated audio clip, read from its WAV header.

real_time_factor.description: audio_duration_s / (generation_time_ms / 1000). Greater than 1 means faster than real-time.

trial_count.description: Number of measured (non-warmup) trials included in aggregated metrics.

prompt_chars.description: Character length of the prompt used for every trial -- generation time depends on it, so this must be recorded for reproducibility.

lyrics_chars.description: Character length of the lyrics passed on the request, if any.

vocal_language.description: Vocal language passed on the request, if any.

validity.description: Confounder controls. A run that fails a gate must set valid=false and record why.

valid.description: False if any hard gate failed. Invalid runs are shown but never ranked.

warmup_discarded.description: True if warmup iterations were excluded from timing.

exclusive_run.description: True if no competing model workload ran during measurement, per server-verified /api/v1/health polling where possible.

model_reload_free.description: True if the model stayed resident for the whole run (no reload tax).

notes.description: Any flags, caveats, or reasons a gate failed.
